name: Delegated gate: no verdict — a delegated push was refused with nothing decided
description: Fires when a delegated gate run emits livespec.gate.outcome=no-verdict: the run obtained NO VERDICT, which is the delegation's fault rather than the pushing repository's, and is what a reader cannot otherwise tell apart from a red tree (outcome=failed-tree). livespec.gate.repository, .tree_hash and .job_name name the run; job_name is absent when the run stopped before the API server assigned one. Emitter: livespec-dev-tooling livespec_dev_tooling/gate_outcome_telemetry.py, called from livespec_dev_tooling/gate_remote_delegate.py. Receiver: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml. Item: livespec-dev-tooling-cmgqnz. Runbook: read the refused push's log for the step that did not complete; then on the pushing host check that /etc/ci-runner/gates.kubeconfig is readable by THAT process (a login session predating gates-client membership is not — use /usr/bin/sg), the gates namespace API server, and any Job the run did submit. Value trigger; silence is not evidence a delegated push succeeded.
